mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the past year signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 3-month window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A one-time upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 310 signals accelerating inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not cross above 310 in the expected month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand proxies (GDPC1 and HOUST) alongside a decline in supply (INDPRO below 102.7) indicates strong demand outpacing supply, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in UNRATE below 3.5% during a late-cycle expansion signals weakening labor demand, prompting investors to anticipate economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not fall below 3.5% in the expected month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in UNRATE over the past 12 months reflects weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 6-month window, or 20-day returns in such periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A one-time upward crossing of FEDFUNDS above 5.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not cross above 5.5% in the expected month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low demand (GDPC1 below 22,000) and high supply (INDPRO above 105) indicates economic overproduction, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-month window, or 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS below 700,000 during a monetary tightening cycle signals contractionary demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or RSAFS does not fall below 700,000 in the expected month.
